title: Launching Health in ChatGPT
summary: Health in ChatGPT now lets eligible U.S. users securely connect medical records and Apple Health to get more personalized insights and better understand their health.
body: Health in ChatGPT now lets eligible U.S. users securely connect medical records and Apple Health to get more personalized insights and better understand their health.
summaryZh: OpenAI宣布在ChatGPT中正式推出健康（Health）功能。符合条件的美国用户现在可以安全地将个人医疗记录和Apple Health数据连接至ChatGPT，从而获得更加个性化的健康洞察并更好地理解健康状况。
